title: Thrift: Complete handling of Binary & Compact protocols
description:
- Make sure reassembly requests & errors are properly propagated from
  any point in the PDU, no matter how many sub-structure levels.
- Handle the sub-dissection methods as well:
  - Ensure the sub-dissection methods handle errors from previous calls.
  - Reduce the error handling needed in sub-dissector implementations.
  - Add missing sub-dissection methods for list, set, and map.
  - Add the handling of sub-structure.
- Handle Compact protocol in addition to the existing binary protocol.
  - Include and improve MR !3171
  - Handle reassembly the same way as for binary protocol.
  - Handle sub-dissection with the same functions.
    => Sub-dissectors only depend on .thrift files.

Additional changes:
- Use of constants instead of hard-coded values.
- Removed U64 support (never supported by thrift code generator, only
  referenced in the C++ thrift library header but not supported in reality.
- Removed references to UTF-8 and UTF-16 string for the same reason.
- Replaced references to UTF-7 string with just string (same reason).
- Replaced references to byte with i8 as the documentation explicitly
  states that byte is a compatibility name.

Documentation reference:
- https://thrift.apache.org/developers
- https://thrift.apache.org/docs/idl.html
- https://github.com/apache/thrift/blob/master/doc/specs/thrift-compact-protocol.md
- https://erikvanoosten.github.io/thrift-missing-specification/
- https://diwakergupta.github.io/thrift-missing-guide/

Closes #16244

notes.body:
Hello @richvdh & @AndersBroman,

Complete version is finally there.
Fuzzing is in progress and I need to generate more test cases but I see no reason for holding the MR any more.

I managed to modify our device simulator and tester to use Compact protocol instead of Binary and sub-dissection worked wonderfully with the same sub-dissector (except for the fact that it detected a bug in the simulator —a missing mandatory field— :laughing:).

Now, I need to write public examples (Jaeger is a good start) for the documentation.

Why don't add type THRIFT to tvb_get_varing_enc ?

I didn't find any `tvb_get_varint_enc` function (checked in epan/tvbuff.h), just the currently used `tvb_get_varint` which takes `ENC_VARINT_PROTOBUF` or `ENC_VARINT_ZIGZAG`, both used by Thrift depending on the dissected element.

In any case, this is only a wrapper around said `tvb_get_varint` to handle the reassembly in an easier way: instead of duplicating the checks and expert info in case of error 10 times, I just check the return code for reassembly.

If you have an idea to reduce boilerplate without this kind of wrapper function, I'm interested.
Note that I have the same kind of wrapping by `dissect_thrift_t_field_header` around `dissect_thrift_field_header`, both of these functions being used in different circumstances.

New update (+rebase) due to an issue found during development of jaeger sub-dissector.

The `previous_field_id` value was not correctly reset at the beginning of struct, leading to 2 issues:
* field id for generic dissection in compact protocol was incorrectly displayed when delta was used.
* due to calculated field id being unaligned with theoretical one, sub-dissection failed with "missing mandatory field" (or could have been wrong type or wrong field dissected if the types happened to match).

Now, the jaeger capture is properly dissected by the dedicated sub-dissector. :tada:
Jaeger sub-dissector is published on a dedicated branch of my repository and documentation on https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/Thrift describes the creation process.

commits_data.title: Thrift: Complete handling of Binary & Compact protocols
commits_data.message:
Thrift: Complete handling of Binary & Compact protocols

- Make sure reassembly requests & errors are properly propagated from
  any point in the PDU, no matter how many sub-structure levels.
- Handle the sub-dissection methods as well:
  - Ensure the sub-dissection methods handle errors from previous calls.
  - Reduce the error handling needed in sub-dissector implementations.
  - Add missing sub-dissection methods for list, set, and map.
  - Add the handling of sub-structure.
- Handle Compact protocol in addition to the existing binary protocol.
  - Include and improve MR !3171
  - Handle reassembly the same way as for binary protocol.
  - Handle sub-dissection with the same functions.
    => Sub-dissectors only depend on .thrift files.

Additional changes:
- Use of constants instead of hard-coded values.
- Removed U64 support (never supported by thrift code generator, only
  referenced in the C++ thrift library header but not supported in reality.
- Removed references to UTF-8 and UTF-16 string for the same reason.
- Replaced references to UTF-7 string with just string (same reason).
- Replaced references to byte with i8 as the documentation explicitly
  states that byte is a compatibility name.

Documentation reference:
- https://thrift.apache.org/developers
- https://thrift.apache.org/docs/idl.html
- https://github.com/apache/thrift/blob/master/doc/specs/thrift-compact-protocol.md
- https://erikvanoosten.github.io/thrift-missing-specification/
- https://diwakergupta.github.io/thrift-missing-guide/

Closes #16244

Additional changes:
- Add authors and improve consistency
- Fix typo and clarify documentation
